notes.zh: 登录页新增《服务协议》和《个人信息保护指引》，勾选同意后登录。「关于 PesaBell」里也能查看这两份文件。
notes.en: The login screen now shows the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy: tick the circle to agree, then log in. Both are also under About PesaBell.
notes.sw: Skrini ya kuingia sasa ina Masharti ya Huduma na Sera ya Faragha: bonyeza duara kukubali, kisha uingie. Zote mbili ziko pia kwenye Kuhusu PesaBell.
